title: Episode 110 opens with the story of Mehtab Singh

blocks.text: This page is another hinge, because it finishes the Bhai Taru Singh opening and then clearly launches Episode 110 with the praise-laden heading for Mehtab Singh. The narrator tells readers to listen now to the second tale of Mehtab Singh, signaling a fresh martial episode rather than a continuation of the previous one.

Harbhagat and Mughal forces move to seize Mehtab Singh, but his fame as a fearless Singh already terrifies his enemies. The Singhs keep to hidden terrain and remain prepared for battle, while the search for him spreads through the countryside.

The page also ties this new episode back to the Lahore setting created by Taru Singh's imprisonment, so the transition feels deliberate rather than abrupt. Its repaired summary therefore needs to name both the narrative handoff and the new focus on Mehtab Singh's coming clash with Mughal authority.
